from datetime import timedelta

from django.contrib.auth import get_user_model
from django.test import TestCase
from django.utils import timezone
from rest_framework.test import APIClient

from groceries.models import GroceryItem, GroceryList
from users.models import FamilyGroup, FamilyMembership

User = get_user_model()


class GroceryMobileVisibilityApiTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.user = User.objects.create_user(
            username="mobilegroceries", password="test123"
        )
        self.family = FamilyGroup.objects.create(name="Mobile Visibility Family")
        FamilyMembership.objects.create(
            user=self.user,
            family=self.family,
            role="PARENT",
            is_active=True,
        )

        self.grocery_list = GroceryList.objects.create(
            family=self.family,
            owner=self.user,
            name="Weekend Run",
        )
        self.open_item = GroceryItem.objects.create(
            grocery_list=self.grocery_list,
            name="Milk",
            position=0,
            created_by=self.user,
        )
        self.recent_completed_item = GroceryItem.objects.create(
            grocery_list=self.grocery_list,
            name="Bread",
            is_completed=True,
            position=1,
            completed_at=timezone.now() - timedelta(minutes=5),
            created_by=self.user,
        )
        self.stale_completed_item = GroceryItem.objects.create(
            grocery_list=self.grocery_list,
            name="Eggs",
            is_completed=True,
            position=2,
            completed_at=timezone.now() - timedelta(minutes=16),
            created_by=self.user,
        )

        self.client = APIClient()
        self.client.force_authenticate(user=self.user)

    def test_list_detail_hides_stale_completed_items(self):
        response = self.client.get(f"/api/groceries/lists/{self.grocery_list.id}/")

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        item_names = [item["name"] for item in response.json()["items"]]
        self.assertEqual(item_names, ["Milk", "Bread"])

    def test_list_summary_counts_ignore_stale_completed_items(self):
        response = self.client.get(
            "/api/groceries/lists/",
            {"family": str(self.family.id)},
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        results = response.json()["results"]
        list_summary = next(
            item for item in results if item["id"] == str(self.grocery_list.id)
        )
        self.assertEqual(list_summary["item_count"], 2)
        self.assertEqual(list_summary["completed_item_count"], 1)
        self.assertEqual(list_summary["completion_percentage"], 50.0)

    def test_aggregate_view_hides_stale_completed_items(self):
        response = self.client.get(
            "/api/groceries/aggregate/",
            {"family": str(self.family.id)},
        )

        self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200)
        item_names = [item["name"] for item in response.json()]
        self.assertEqual(item_names, ["Milk", "Bread"])

    def test_toggle_response_includes_completed_timestamp_and_clears_on_reopen(self):
        complete_response = self.client.post(
            f"/api/groceries/items/{self.open_item.id}/toggle/"
        )

        self.assertEqual(complete_response.status_code, 200)
        self.open_item.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertTrue(self.open_item.is_completed)
        self.assertIsNotNone(self.open_item.completed_at)
        self.assertEqual(
            complete_response.json()["completed_at"],
            self.open_item.completed_at.isoformat(),
        )

        reopen_response = self.client.post(
            f"/api/groceries/items/{self.open_item.id}/toggle/"
        )

        self.assertEqual(reopen_response.status_code, 200)
        self.open_item.refresh_from_db()
        self.assertFalse(self.open_item.is_completed)
        self.assertIsNone(self.open_item.completed_at)
        self.assertIsNone(reopen_response.json()["completed_at"])

    brand_count = serializers.IntegerField(read_only=True)

        model = FamilyProductPreference
        fields = [
            "id",

            "primary_brand",
            "brand_count",
            "photo_count",
            "first_photo_url",
        ]

    def get_first_photo_url(self, obj):
        first_photo = obj.photos.first()
        return first_photo.photo_url if first_photo else None


class MobileVisibleListMetricsMixin:
    def _get_visible_items(self, obj) -> list[GroceryItem]:
        cache = self.context.setdefault("_mobile_visible_items_cache", {})
        cache_key = str(obj.id)

                    "assigned_to",
                    "created_by",
                    "category",
                    "grocery_category",
                    "product_preference",
                )

class MobileVisibleListMetricsMixin:
    def _get_visible_items(self, obj) -> list[GroceryItem]:
        cache = self.context.setdefault("_mobile_visible_items_cache", {})
        cache_key = str(obj.id)
        if cache_key in cache:
            return cache[cache_key]

        prefetched_items = getattr(obj, "_prefetched_objects_cache", {}).get("items")
        if prefetched_items is None:
            prefetched_items = (
                obj.items.select_related(
                    "planned_store",
                    "assigned_to",
                    "created_by",
                    "category",
                    "grocery_category",
                    "product_preference",
                )
                .prefetch_related("labels")
                .order_by("position")
            )

        visible_items = filter_mobile_visible_items(prefetched_items)
        cache[cache_key] = visible_items
        return visible_items

    def _get_visible_metrics(self, obj) -> tuple[int, int, float]:
        visible_items = self._get_visible_items(obj)
        total_count = len(visible_items)
        completed_count = sum(1 for item in visible_items if item.is_completed)
        completion_percentage = (
            (completed_count / total_count) * 100 if total_count > 0 else 0

) -> dict:

    store = (

def _validate_grocery_item_category_scope(
    attrs: dict,
    *,
    instance: GroceryItem | None,
) -> dict:
    should_validate = (
        instance is None or "grocery_category" in attrs or "grocery_list" in attrs
    )
    if not should_validate:
        return attrs

    grocery_list = attrs.get("grocery_list") or (
        instance.grocery_list if instance else None
    )
    grocery_category = (
        attrs.get("grocery_category")
        if "grocery_category" in attrs
        else (instance.grocery_category if instance else None)
    )

    if not grocery_list or not grocery_category:
        return attrs

    if grocery_category.family_id != grocery_list.family_id:
        raise serializers.ValidationError(
            {
                "grocery_category": (
                    "Category must belong to the same family as the grocery list."
                )
            }

        ).exists():

            )

    def validate(self, attrs):
        attrs = super().validate(attrs)
        family = attrs.get("family")
        product_name = attrs.get("product_name")
        instance = getattr(self, "instance", None)

        if instance and family is None:
            family = instance.family
        if instance and product_name is None:
            product_name = instance.product_name

        if family and product_name:
            existing = FamilyProductPreference.objects.filter(
                family=family,
                product_name=product_name,
                is_active=True,
            )
            if instance:
                existing = existing.exclude(id=instance.id)
            if existing.exists():
                raise serializers.ValidationError(
                    {
                        "product_name": (
                            "A product preference with this name already exists for "
                            "this family."
                        )
                    }
                )

        return attrs

    def create(self, validated_data):

                {

                        "A product preference with this name already exists for "
                        "this family."
                    )
                }
            ) from exc

        # Create brands with auto-ordering
        for idx, brand_data in enumerate(brands_data, start=1):
            ProductBrand.objects.create(
                product_preference=preference,
                name=brand_data.get("name", ""),
                preference_order=brand_data.get("preference_order", idx),

            )

        return preference

class MobileVisibleListMetricsMixin(serializers.Serializer):
    def _get_visible_items(self, obj) -> list[GroceryItem]:
        cache = self.context.setdefault("_mobile_visible_items_cache", {})
        cache_key = str(obj.id)
        if cache_key in cache:
            return cache[cache_key]

        prefetched_items = getattr(obj, "_prefetched_objects_cache", {}).get("items")
        if prefetched_items is None:
            prefetched_items = (
                obj.items.select_related(
                    "planned_store",
                    "assigned_to",
                    "created_by",
                    "category",
                    "grocery_category",
                    "product_preference",
                )
                .prefetch_related("labels")
                .order_by("position")
            )

        visible_items = filter_mobile_visible_items(prefetched_items)
        cache[cache_key] = visible_items
        return visible_items

    def _get_visible_metrics(self, obj) -> tuple[int, int, float]:
        visible_items = self._get_visible_items(obj)
        total_count = len(visible_items)
        completed_count = sum(1 for item in visible_items if item.is_completed)
        completion_percentage = (
            (completed_count / total_count) * 100 if total_count > 0 else 0
        )
        return total_count, completed_count, completion_percentage
